summary: Sensata Technologies Holding plc filed an 8-K announcing that its wholly owned subsidiaries commenced cash tender offers to purchase up to $350 million aggregate principal of three series of senior notes: 4.000% notes due 2029 (Sensata B.V.), 4.375% notes due 2030 (Sensata, Inc.), and 5.875% notes due 2030 (Sensata B.V.). Holders tendering by the early deadline (May 29, 2026) receive a $50 per $1,000 premium. The offers expire June 15, 2026, subject to proration. The transaction reduces leverage and interest expense. Watch take-up levels and whether a material portion remains untendered.
